name: Ernestina Kjellberg-Phongsavath
role: Holographic street muralist and unlicensed public art provocateur
location: Pilsen Veil, operating across Mexicantown Libre and Lakeview Neon, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Ernestina Kjellberg-Phongsavath is a broad-shouldered man going soft at the middle, with dark skin mapped by fifty years of lake wind and workshop dust. His beard is full and shot through with silver he has dyed in rotating chromatic bands â€” currently a deep violet fading to copper â€” a vanity he accepts without embarrassment. He moves with the deliberate economy of someone who has been on his feet for three decades and has stopped pretending urgency. His hands are enormous and scarred across the knuckles from old hardware accidents, and he keeps them in constant motion even when he's sitting still.

He projects illegal holo-murals onto corporate architecture using a rig of his own design: a backpack-mounted emitter disguised as an air filtration unit. The murals last twenty minutes before building defense systems scrub them â€” sometimes longer in Pilsen Veil where the buildings remember him fondly, or so he says. He talks constantly and with tremendous warmth, the kind of person who makes strangers feel immediately known and slightly exposed. He has been arrested fourteen times and considers this a reasonable professional overhead.

core_fears: Irrelevance â€” that the murals are just spectacle and change nothing
That he has been a bad father to his two adult children who left GLMZ
core_desires: For someone to point at a piece of city architecture and remember what it looked like before the corponations branded it
To finish one truly permanent work before he gets too old to run
coping_mechanisms: Humor â€” reflex deflection from anything actually painful
Constant movement and sociality; he rarely sits alone with his thoughts
blind_spots: He romanticizes poverty in ways that irritate people who haven't chosen it
Genuinely cannot perceive when his gregariousness is unwanted
psychology.secret: He has a standing verbal agreement with a mid-level Ringo Corp brand manager: Ringo lets him know patrol rotation schedules in exchange for occasionally projecting murals that contain, subtly, Ringo color palettes. He tells himself it's subversion from within. His collective would call it collaboration.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Rich and discursive; code-switches between English, Igbo phrases, and Samoan words his grandmother used; fond of historical references nobody can verify
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and flowing with sudden full stops when something matters to him
verbal_tics: 'You know what I mean?' (rhetorical, doesn't wait for answer)
'My grandmother used to say â€”' (introduces invented or half-remembered wisdom)
example_lines: 'They paint over it, I paint it back. We've been having this conversation for twenty years and neither of us is bored yet.'
'My grandmother used to say a wall with no story on it is just a threat wearing a coat.'
'You want to know who controls a neighborhood? Look at whose face is on the buildings. Then look at whose face isn't.'

story_hooks: A mural he projected two weeks ago onto a Zheng-Dao distribution hub contained, in the holo-code layer most people can't read, a data fragment he picked up from a corrupted ELF shrine â€” he didn't know what it was, just thought it made the colors interesting, but someone very serious is now looking for it
His youngest child has returned to GLMZ after twelve years and is working corporate, and Obinna is managing this with loudly performed equanimity and private devastation
narrative_function: Information broker of the informal economy â€” he has been everywhere at 3 AM for thirty years and notices everything. Natural quest giver for anything involving public space, corporate territory, or community memory. Knows everyone.
augmentations: Color-shifting beard dye (geneware cosmetic treatment, semi-permanent); projection targeting overlay in left eye (basic cyberware); old burn scar on right forearm from early rig accident, deliberately unrepaired
daily_life: Spends mornings at a tea stall in Pilsen Veil arguing with friends and reading old physical newspapers he collects. Afternoons are for prep and equipment maintenance. He projects between 2 and 4 AM when patrol cycles have gaps he's spent years mapping.
affiliation: Independent; loose association with Mexicantown Libre arts council; has a complicated and ongoing relationship with a Ringo Corp street-marketing division that he publicly despises and occasionally accepts commissions from

decision_rules: Never project on residential walls â€” only corporate or civic architecture
If a stranger needs help in the street, he stops. Every time. This has gotten him hurt before.
escalation_ladder: Walks away and does not come back quickly

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and curious; asks names, remembers them; offers tea or food if he has it
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teases relentlessly and shows up at bad moments with exactly the right thing

stress_responses.medium: Jokes with a slightly harder edge
stress_responses.high: Goes very quiet and very still, which people who know him recognize as genuinely alarming

contradictions: He preaches against corporate compromise and accepts corporate money
He says he doesn't care about legacy and has been cataloguing every mural he's ever projected in meticulous personal records
habits: Photographs every site he's worked before and after
Leaves small physical gifts â€” a folded paper, a bottle cap â€” at ELF shrines near his projection sites
Hums to himself when working, always the same three bars of something he can't name
breaking_points: Someone destroying a community-initiated mural, as opposed to a corporate scrub
Being called a tourist in someone else's struggle

timeline.event: 2146 â€” Born in Mexicantown Libre, son of a Nigerian-Danish dockworker and a Samoan medical technician
2165 â€” First illegal projection; a portrait of a demolished community center thrown onto the Ferrogate station that replaced it
2170s â€” Series of fourteen arrests; brief radicalization period; gradually moderated
2200 â€” Current: preparing a month-long nightly projection cycle commemorating the Pilsen Veil flood of 2167

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian dominant (53.4%) with substantial Sub-Saharan African heritage (27.3%), Indigenous American (13.5%), and Hispanic/Latin American (5.8%) ancestry. This genetic constellation manifests in warm, deeply pigmented skin with complex undertonesâ€”the rich mahogany-brown base from blended African and Southeast Asian ancestry, layered with golden-bronze warmth and subtle olive cast. Facial structure reflects the full ancestry: Southeast Asian cheekbone prominence and eye shape, African heritage in nose width and lip fullness, Indigenous American and Hispanic undertones in overall bone structure and complexion depth.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and barrel-chested, softening through the middle with age but still carrying the frame of someone who's spent decades on his feet. Forearms remain ropey with muscle memory.
physical_description.hair_style: Full, well-maintained beard worn long and styled with deliberate care
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (beard); head hair kept close to scalp
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown; left eye has a subtle luminescent targeting reticle visible when ambient light hits it at certain angles
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm mahogany-brown with golden-bronze undertones and subtle olive cast, sun-darkened from decades of outdoor work, reflecting the layered warmth of Southeast Asian, African, Indigenous American, and Hispanic ancestry blended into rich, complex pigmentation
physical_description.complexion: Heavily lined faceâ€”creases around eyes and mouth from constant talking and laughter. Skin texture roughened by workshop dust and lake wind exposure. Facial structure shows Southeast Asian cheekbone definition balanced with African heritage width in nose and lip fullness, with Indigenous American and Hispanic ancestry contributing to overall bone prominence. Grooming is meticulous despite worn appearance; beard is regularly conditioned.
distinguishing_marks: Old burn scar across right forearm from early rig accidentâ€”deliberately left unrepaired, pale and mottled against darker skin, approximately 12cm long running from wrist toward elbow
Multiple thin scars across knuckles of both hands, white against darker skin, from decades of hardware work and accidents
The beard itself serves as a permanent distinguishing feature: currently dyed in rotating chromatic bands of deep violet fading to copper, refreshed every 6-8 weeks
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye projection targeting overlay appears as faint geometric patterns visible only when light catches the eye at certain angles. Backpack-mounted holo-emitter disguised as an air filtration unit when carrying his rig. Otherwise augmentations are minimal and mostly invisible to casual observation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical grace born of three decades on his feetâ€”no wasted motion, but never rushed. Hands are in constant subtle motion even when seated, gesturing while speaking, fidgeting with small objects. Head tilts forward slightly when listening intently. Carries himself with the unselfconscious confidence of someone long comfortable in his own skin.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional with deliberate artistic flair. Favors layered, weathered utilitarian pieces: worn canvas work pants, thermal base layers visible at collar and wrists, oversized linen or hemp overshirts in muted earth tones. Often wears a long coat of synthetic leather that's seen better days but is carefully maintained. Work boots that are scuffed but well-oiled. Jewelry is minimal but intentionalâ€”a silver ring on one hand, possibly hand-made. No visible corporate branding; aesthetic is deliberately anti-corpo while remaining accessible to working-class spaces he frequents.
